name: DevLab CI/CD Onboard
summary: Provider-neutral CI/CD onboarding: inspect repository facts, select a minimal pipeline, separate repository configuration from secrets, and verify releases without binding to a private platform.
runtime_requirements: The bundled Jenkins-style validator requires PyYAML; jsonschema is required when --schema is used.
Choose a CI provider and supply its runner, plugins, permissions, and secret store separately; GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and Woodpecker are not bundled dependencies.
post_install_hints: Review existing CI files before proposing a provider migration.
Use the CI provider's secret store for credentials and endpoints; keep tracked configuration portable.
Validate any project-local Jenkins-style configuration with scripts/validate-jenkins-yml.py before committing it.
